description: Figure 5 is a line plot that displays the performance of different DPR (Dense Passage Retrieval) models on the dev set of MS-Marco, measured by MRR@10 (Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10). The x-axis, labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)", is a linear scale ranging from 2 to 10, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "MRR@10", is a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The plot compares four models: DPR w/o query (black solid line), DPR w/ corpus expansion (red solid line with circle markers), DPR w/ document expansion (green solid line with triangle markers), and DPR w/ asymmetric expansion (blue solid line with square markers). The DPR w/o query model shows a relatively flat performance, starting at approximately 34.7 and ending at about 34.6. The DPR w/ corpus expansion model starts at about 35.0 and shows a steady increase, reaching a peak of approximately 35.8 at S=10. The DPR w/ document expansion model begins at around 34.8 and remains relatively stable, ending at about 34.8. The DPR w/ asymmetric expansion model starts at approximately 34.7, dips to around 34.5 at S=4, and then rises to about 34.7 at S=10.
